summary: PLATE 0.8.0 — Autonomy, adoption, and packaging foundations (188 changes). Ships durable budget rails, decision ledger, checkpoints/shadow gates, endless feed + Q&A planning, PM/fleet/bug/feature loops, scheduled ops, release media + marketplace packaging helpers, hybrid project kinds, import-payload + adoption under-30m path, self-migrate dry-run/verify, SPEC audit, and Contemplation provenance/mutation plans. Human Tasks remain for PyPI/marketplace publish (#626/#625/#380/#381). v1.0 browser PM client (#661) deferred.
